title: OT network device configuration backups
requirement: Current configuration backups of every OT boundary/network device shall be retained, not older than 30 days, with integrity hash recorded.

title: Individually accountable user accounts
requirement: Every human user shall have a unique, individually accountable account. Shared or generic interactive accounts are prohibited.

title: Compensating controls approved and in validity
requirement: Each compensating countermeasure shall have a risk owner, formal approval, and a validity date that has not lapsed.

title: Annual external and periodic self-audits
requirement: An annual external audit and quarterly internal self-audits shall be completed and recorded.
control_ref: IEC 62443-2-1 (programme review); IT Act s.70 Protected System Rules

clause: IT Act 2000, s.70 + Protected System Rules 2018
title: Protected System governance
requirement: Protected System notified, CISO appointed, access limited to authorised persons, and periodic information security audit performed.

title: Log retention 180 days within India
requirement: ICT system logs shall be enabled and retained securely for a rolling period of 180 days within Indian jurisdiction.

title: Zone & conduit boundary protection
requirement: No direct traffic from Corporate IT to Level 1 control zone. Conduits default-deny; only documented flows permitted.

title: Strong authentication for privileged users
requirement: Privileged users use MFA; passwords min 12 chars; account lockout after unsuccessful attempts enabled.

title: Authorisation of control-write operations
requirement: Write commands to controllers permitted only from authorised engineering stations.

title: Protection of data in transit, at rest and in backup
requirement: TLS 1.2 or higher in transit; encryption at rest; backups encrypted.
